name: Gate and Fencing (820m x 2.5m; electric telescopic door 2x; fence gate 6x; 3.0m x 250m + 2.4m x 250m steel grating fence)
description: Evidence: one readable manufacturer datasheet for motorised telescopic sliding gates with printed dimensions, speeds, duty, safety and coating standards. No published fencing rate, steel-grating datasheet or Malaysian supplier evidence found; bidder quantities are design data.
aliases: Gate and Fencing (820m x 2.5m; electric telescopic door 2x; fence gate 6x; 3.0m x 250m + 2.4m x 250m steel grating fence)

gaps.what: Gate and Fencing (820m x 2.5m; electric telescopic door 2x; fence gate 6x; 3.0m x 250m + 2.4m x 250m steel grating fence)
gaps.why: No published rate per metre for 2.5 m fencing or steel grating fence, and no datasheet for the specified steel grating fence; GEAPL is an Indian manufacturer and is not evidence of supply to this project.
gaps.next_action: Source a Malaysian fence/grating supplier datasheet and a published RM/m rate for perimeter fencing and gates.

gaps.what: Gate and Fencing (820m x 2.5m; electric telescopic door 2x; fence gate 6x; 3.0m x 250m + 2.4m x 250m steel grating fence)
gaps.why: The 820 m, gate counts and 250 m grating lengths are bidder-supplied design figures, not evidence.
gaps.next_action: Do not present these figures as sourced facts.
